_implementation_notes: CERULEAN EXTRAS FILL — Maps 2 (PokeMart), 3 (Player's House), 6 (Team Rocket HQ).
Map 2 (PokeMart):
- EV016/017/018/020/024/025: Shelf text ('The shelves are filled...'). MECHANICAL — preserved exactly.
- EV028: Plant decoration text. MECHANICAL — preserved exactly.
- EV019: Exotic Pokemon NPC (Johto outfit unlock quest). MECHANICAL quest — preserved all
start_indices, choices, and unlock messages. Lightly rewrote flavor intro lines only.
- EV003 (Deliveryman): Mystery gift delivery system. MECHANICAL — preserved exactly.
- EV004: DNA Reverser tip NPC. Rewritten with Synthesis flavor.
Map 3 (Player's House):
- EV003: Mom NPC. Page 0 = running shoes gift + goodbye (MECHANICAL gift preserved,
flavor rewritten). Page 1 = heal at home (MECHANICAL heal preserved, flavor rewritten).
Map 6 (Team Rocket HQ):
- EV016: Debug/testing event. MECHANICAL — preserved exactly.
- EV027/028: Vent/pipe foul odor flavor text. Rewritten with Synthesis grit.
- EV005: Window reflection text. Rewritten.
- EV011: Grunt yelling about uniform. Rewritten with ideologue tone.
- EV017: Cutscene — bug infestation panic. Rewritten with hired-muscle tone.
- EV006 (Petrel): Major NPC, squad captain intro + bug quest. MECHANICAL choices preserved.
All dialogue rewritten with Synthesis Petrel voice — sardonic, competent, not cartoon villain.
- EV018/010: Grunts referencing 'situation downstairs'. Rewritten with professional tone.
- EV007 (Trainer/Guard): Gate guard across 6 pages. All mechanical references to Captain Petrel,
switch logic preserved. Flavor rewritten.
- EV002: Confidential mission brief document. MECHANICAL document content preserved.
Flavor text around it rewritten.
- EV008: Grunt claiming HQ. Rewritten across 3 pages.
- EV003/004: Giovanni speech grunts. Rewritten.
- EV009: Employee Handbook + hidden note. MECHANICAL password/variable preserved. Flavor rewritten.
- EV021 (Petrel downstairs): Post-bug-quest + mission assignments. MECHANICAL choices, gold
rewards (\G), variable refs (\V[]) all preserved exactly. Flavor rewritten.
Tone: Cerulean PokeMart is routine commerce. Player's House is warm but bittersweet — Mom knows
this journey is real. Team Rocket HQ grunts are working people in a bad organization, not
caricatures. Petrel is sharp and sardonic.
Line length limit: ~42 characters per line for RPG Maker XP text box.
